description: This Java class implements the CommandStrategy interface to delete a specific datatable entry for an entity in the Apache Fineract project. It processes batch requests, interacts with DatatablesApiResource to perform deletion, and constructs BatchResponse objects.

classes.name: DeleteDatatableEntryOneToOneCommandStrategy
classes.description: A Spring component implementing CommandStrategy to handle deletion of datatable entries for a specified entity based on batch requests.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a BatchRequest to delete a datatable entry, interacts with DatatablesApiResource, and returns a BatchResponse indicating success or failure.
